name: founderscope
description: Editorial company-research tool. Fusion language: serif-display warmth over Padzy structural discipline (mono data, numbered kickers, hairline grids, one accent tick).

accent.name: amber / ochre
accent.note: Amber #c0792b on charcoal #101012 ≈ 6:1 (AA text). White-on-amber fails, so amber fills use dark ink.

overrides: Serif display (Fraunces) instead of the Padzy default PP Neue Machina — confirmed product override.
No signature motif — the Padzy node/bracket mark is deliberately dropped; brand uses the amber brushstroke 'F'.
Hybrid numerals: large display numerals stay serif; all inline data/units/timestamps/IDs are mono.
